literature_notes: LRRC8D has four transmembrane helices with two extracellular loops (ECL1: 49–163; ECL2: 331–360), an intracellular N-terminus (1–23), and a large intracellular C-terminal LRR domain (387–858). Every ledger line that names a tag position places it at the C-terminus: L1/L2 (human LRRC8D, C-terminal GFP-His8 / EGFP in Sf9 cells), L3 (mouse LRRC8D, C-terminal mCherry in Sf9 cells), and L5 (full-length LRRC8D, C-terminal Venus-myc-SBP). The C-terminus (residue 858) falls within INTRACELLULAR_3 (387–858) and therefore does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. L4 reports an 'epitope-tagged' LRRC8D knock-in mouse but names neither the tag type nor the insertion residue, so no junction can be pinned. L6 reports a tdTomato fusion to the endogenous LRRC8D locus but likewise names no position. Because no ledger line grounds an insertion on the extracellular face, the site list is empty.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP-His8 tag on full-length human LRRC8D expressed in Sf9 cells; C-terminus falls in INTRACELLULAR_3 (387–858), not on the extracellular surface.
C-terminal mCherry tag on full-length mouse LRRC8D expressed in Sf9 cells for cryo-EM; C-terminus is intracellular (ortholog, same topology).
C-terminal Venus-myc-SBP tag on full-length human LRRC8D for transient transfection and BacMam expression; C-terminus is intracellular.
